claims.claim: Kratos disclosed a >$20M mobile SATCOM gateway contract on September 1, 2026 and an approximately $35M national-security military-grade hardware production award on August 31, extending demand across resilient communications and defense hardware.

risks.risk: Classified/customer-constrained disclosures limit visibility into program economics and concentration.

unknowns.unknown: Current segment margins, backlog conversion and acquisition effects require Alpha underwriting.

claims.claim: The recent production and SATCOM awards support continued execution across multiple defense lanes, but the test is timely conversion of awards into profitable production at scale.

risks.risk: Government procurement timing and classified program opacity can obscure execution slippage.

unknowns.unknown: Exact profitability and delivery schedule of the new awards are undisclosed.
